verdict.rationale: YPOG's own Transactions page says it advises on "high-profile exit transactions" and frames its service as "from inception to exit." Its Corporate page says it advises on IPO preparations for clients that include venture-capital-backed growth companies. Both are short, generic statements, with no named exit or IPO deals, no dedicated M&A or IPO practice detail, and no independent corroboration. Missing for 10: named M&A exit and IPO case studies for venture-backed companies, a dedicated M&A/IPO practice page describing scope, and independent corroboration of the exit track record.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm can carry the company through to exit — M&A and public-offering experience for venture-backed companies is documented on its own pages

citations.quote: Well advised from inception to exit.
Our transaction experts regularly provide advice and support on the largest German equity financing rounds, venture debt and high-profile exit transactions
with many years of experience in capital market law, we also advise, amongst others, on preparations for an IPO
